name: Darwin Plus Main

funder.name: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra)

summary: UK government grants of £50,000 to £1 million for environmental projects of six months to three years that benefit biodiversity and climate resilience in the UK Overseas Territories.
reporting: Annual and half-year progress reports, reviewed each year, against the project's objectives (outputs, ethics, environmental impact), plus a final report at the end of the award.

status.quote: Applications to Round 14 of Darwin Plus Main are now closed.

opens.quote: The applications for Round 14 opened on Friday 8th May 2026.

administered_by.quote: NIRAS Darwin Plus Administrator and first point of contact for projects and applicants.

geography.quote: Darwin Plus funding is open to applications for projects in all UKOTs.

access.quote: All applications should be submitted via the Flexi-Grant application portal.

window.quote: Applications to Darwin Plus Main are a two-stage process.

amount.quote: Darwin Plus Main is intended for environmental projects of benefit to the UK Overseas Territories (UKOTs), offering grants between £50,000 and £1 million

co_finance_required.quote: Matched funding is strongly encouraged but not mandatory.

reporting.quote: All projects must provide Annual and Half Year progress reports that are reviewed each year.
